artist.name: BOMBIE
artist.bio: Bombie is a DJ and producer based in Bengaluru. Her sets cover electro, breaks, jungle, footwork, UK garage, dub, house and techno. She made her Magnetic Fields debut in the BUDxYARD lineup in December 2024 and recorded Wild City #263 in 2026.

eras.sound: Electro, breakbeat, UK garage and acid with rattling percussion
